check: Agent FRC 0.100.0 preliminary-check --write-view --require-checked ran in private custody on the complete package; receipt.json here is its output and pins every withheld file by SHA-256.
disposition: B'x is selected for preliminary review only. The guarded-pan baseline A remains the fallback pending bench gates G1-G4.

rightsGate.question: Does the published preliminary scene contain only block-level layout solids, with no tessellated supplier or vendor geometry and no private CAD bytes?

step.method: Every face of every STEP solid classified by OCCT surface type with BRepAdaptor_Surface
step.note: The face-type audit covered the original 68-solid layout STEP (sha256 d7af6a7116016e387f0e095daf80e9d93fbf34f4a48b9e68d6f1bb014233b1de). package.step is now the same 67 robot solids re-exported by name, and the L1 trough moved to field-fixtures.step as a motion-study fixture; no solid was reshaped.

rightsGate.finding: All 68 solids are bounded only by planes and cylinders. None carries a B-spline, Bezier, offset or swept surface or a triangulated supplier facet. The largest are the four module housings, at 279 planes and 13-14 cylinders each: fused oriented boxes cut by the revolved steer envelope. The supplier-derived blocks (chassis, module housings, steer sweeps and electronics) reduce supplier parts to boxes, box unions or a 4 mm-stepped revolved envelope. They reproduce no supplier surface.
